candidates.title: OpenAI Reasoning Model Solves Erdos Unit Distance Conjecture
candidates.description: OpenAI published a historic research breakthrough where an internal general-purpose reasoning model independently disproved the Erdos unit distance conjecture, a famous discrete geometry problem posed by Paul Erdos in 1946. The proof, which utilized algebraic number theory in a novel way, was verified by external experts, including Fields Medalist Tim Gowers.
candidates.significance: This marks the first time a frontier artificial intelligence has generated a novel, validated solution to an unsolved high-level mathematical conjecture, indicating a shift from synthetic knowledge retrieval to genuine automated scientific reasoning.

candidates.title: NVIDIA Launches RTX Spark Consumer SoC for Local AI Agents
candidates.description: At Computex 2026, NVIDIA announced the RTX Spark SoC, its first ARM-based consumer processor co-developed with MediaTek. Integrating a Blackwell GPU, a 20-core Grace CPU, and up to 128GB of unified memory, the processor delivers 1 petaflop of local AI compute, allowing consumer laptops to run 120-billion-parameter LLMs locally.
candidates.significance: This transitions high-capability AI agents from being reliant on expensive cloud computing to running locally and privately on consumer devices, laying the hardware foundation for ubiquitous personal AI.

candidates.title: U.S. President Signs National Security Presidential Memorandum (NSPM-11) on Military AI Integration
candidates.description: President Donald J. Trump signed National Security Presidential Memorandum (NSPM-11), establishing a formal framework to rapidly onboard commercial and open-source AI models onto classified military and intelligence networks. The memo also orders updated directives for autonomous weapon systems and strictly prohibits AI use for domestic surveillance or political censorship.
candidates.significance: Sets the formal framework for the integration of modern LLMs and AI agents into national defense operations, codifying how state-level defense apparatuses deploy cutting-edge AI software.

candidates.title: U.S. Congress Unveils 'Great American Artificial Intelligence Act' Draft
candidates.description: Representatives Jay Obernolte and Lori Trahan introduced a 269-page draft of the 'Great American Artificial Intelligence Act'. The bill's key provision is a three-year freeze on state-level AI regulations, designed to preempt upcoming state laws, including Colorado's Consumer Protections for AI Act and various California AI safety bills.
candidates.significance: Represents the first comprehensive federal legislative attempt to unify AI regulation across the United States, prioritizing a single national standard over a fragmented patchwork of state-level restrictions.
